title: Brandy Crusta
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut a lemon in half. Pare the full peel off half and squeeze the juice from the lemon. Prepare a glass by moistening the rim with lemon and dipping it in sugar, then carefully curling the lemon peel around the inside of the glass. Combine all of the ingredients in a shaker with ice, shake and strain into glass and add 1 small cube of ice.
